summary: Admin panel v2 (delete cleanup cascade, activity log, monthly reset) fully tested. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests pass in test_admin_v2.py — DELETE cascades owned orgs (orgs_removed>=1) and removes user memberships; admin cannot delete self (400); GET /admin/activity is 403 for non-admin, 200 for admin with newest-first entries containing actor_email/action/target_label/detail/created_at, and captures suspend, role_change, org_update, grant_all, delete actions; POST /admin/credits/monthly-reset is 403 for non-admin, and force-refills a throwaway org's credits from 7 to 200 (free plan allowance) with updated>=1. Frontend: logged in as admin@aiplatform.com, /app/admin shows 4 tabs. admin-tab-activity opens Activity list with 16+ entries rendering action badges (Monthly Reset, Delete, Org Update, Grant All, Role Change, Suspend, Reactivate), target labels, actor 'admin@aiplatform.com', and timestamps. admin-monthly-reset-btn in Organizations tab next to admin-grant-all-btn triggers monthly reset and immediately produces a new Monthly Reset activity entry ('54 orgs · credits refilled to plan allowance'). Delete entries in the log show 'cascaded 1 owned org(s)'. All regression flows still work.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_api.delete_user cascades across ~10 collections (creations, projects, api_keys, agents, memories, etc.) and owned orgs — good coverage. Consider wrapping in a transaction or at least logging partial-failure state if any collection delete throws.

billing.monthly_reset.apply_monthly_reset(force=True) resets ALL orgs regardless of last_reset_month — matches expected 'manual trigger' semantics. Consider surfacing per-plan breakdown in the response (currently only {updated: n}).
admin_activity is capped at 300 entries via find().sort().to_list(300) — acceptable; if long-term audit is required later, add pagination + a background archival job.
Activity entries render nicely with data-testid admin-activity-<id>; consider adding a filter/search by action type as the log grows.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@aiplatform.com / admin12345 (verified). Throwaway TEST_* users created and cleaned via cascade delete.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral throwaway users TEST_cascade_*, TEST_act_*, TEST_mreset_*, TEST_actguard_*, TEST_mrguard_* — most cleaned up by delete cascade tests; a couple of guard-only users may remain (they have their own orgs but no other data). Manual monthly-reset was invoked twice (as expected by spec) — every org's credits are now at plan allowance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin v2 is stable. New pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_v2.py covers delete cascade, activity log, and monthly reset. Note: calling POST /admin/credits/monthly-reset resets ALL orgs' credits to plan allowance — do NOT run in tests where other org credit state must be preserved.
